events.title: We came back from our long weekend ready to work!
events.description:
We came back from our long weekend ready to work! Our scholars are doing a great job getting back into our 2nd grade routines. This week in math, we have been practicing how to:
• Read the problem twice and make sure we understand the information.
• Underline the question and circle the 2 important numbers.
• Use those numbers to help us write an addition or subtraction equation.
• Show our work by always writing an equation! We also learned that when we are missing the whole, we add the two parts together. When we are missing a part, we subtract the known part from the whole, starting with the biggest number. Unit 2 Test Tomorrow: If you would like your scholar to get a little extra practice tonight, we highly recommend printing Workbook Pages 41 and 43 from MyOS. We are so proud of the hard work our scholars have been putting in this week! 💪

events.title: Happy Friday! Next Week: 9/14-9/18
events.description:
Happy Friday, Wonderful Families! We hope this email finds you well! We just wanted to share a few things
with you for the upcoming week. Please don't forget to view the newsletter
each week to see what is coming up! I've attached the newsletter for you to
view, but it is also always posted in MyOS. Each Monday morning, scholars are responsible for writing down their
homework and putting it in their red folder so they know what their
responsibilities are for the week. We realize that sometimes their writing
may not always be clear, or they may not have enough time to completely
copy down all of their homework during the allotted time. Because of this,
we strongly encourage you to also check the newsletter each week to ensure
you have the most up-to-date information regarding homework and upcoming
events. Thank you for helping our scholars build these important habits of
responsibility and independence! Reminder: MAPS Testing
We will begin MAPS testing next week. It is crucial that your scholar comes
to school prepared by having a fully charged computer, charger (just in
case), and headphones! Math Update:
In Math, we are finishing up Chapter 2 today with our test and will be
starting Chapter 3, which will dive deeper into addition and subtraction
with regrouping using 3-digit numbers. Please note that we are working to set your scholar up for success in the
future by requiring them to show their work. Sometimes the questions in our
curriculum do not require equations or certain steps to be written down,
but this is an expectation we have been enforcing in class. The scholars
know that they are expected to show their work, even when the curriculum
does not specifically require it. Thank you for helping reinforce this
expectation at home while they complete their homework! Homework Clarifications
We also wanted to provide a few clarifications regarding our homework
expectations: Please try your best to get HW turned in on time. - For ELA Backpack Pages, please make sure the story page has 3 signatures. These signatures indicate that the story was read 3 different times throughout the week. - Please try your best to get Homework turned in on time. This allows us time to review them, provide feedback, and help your scholar better prepare for any upcoming assessments. Your children have been doing a wonderful job adjusting to all that second
grade brings, and I am so incredibly proud of them! They have been working
hard, learning new routines, becoming more independent, and taking on new
challenges each day. It has been so special watching them grow already this
year! We are looking forward to seeing everyone at Open House on Monday! 9/14-9/18 2nd Grade Newsletter
<https://drive.google.com/open?id=1OOi4MRXLNJcgrNn_8sRG38dqZ5YEXqxRbJly2G3tNrA> If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out. Thank you so
much for your partnership in your child's learning! Have a blessed weekend!

events.title: Happy Monday!
events.description:
Happy Monday, Families! There are quite a few things coming home in scholars’ backpacks today, so
be sure to check those folders! 📚 *Backpack Pages:* These are due Friday. Scholars should work on the
assigned pages throughout the week. Remember to *sign and date the reading
portion 3 times*, please. 📖 *Beanstack:* We practiced logging a read-aloud in class today on
Beanstack! Scholars practiced entering their reading minutes so they are
ready to log their reading at home. 📚 ➕ *Math Homework:* Math homework is also due Friday. Please have your
scholar save the *subtraction practice until later this week*. We will have
a math quiz on *Wednesday* covering addition with regrouping and
subtraction without regrouping. Following the quiz, we will begin
learning *subtraction
with regrouping*. 📊 *Beginning-of-the-Year Data:* Scholars will have a special envelope
coming home for parents. Inside, you will find their beginning-of-the-year
data that we will discuss during conferences. You will see data for *Reading,
Language, and Math*. The "notes" section at the bottom of the conference
form is for you to take notes if you would like. Overall, we had a pretty challenging day getting back into the swing of
things. With the sub tomorrow while I am doing conferences, I reminded
scholars to please be on their *best behavior*. Please remind your child
what it looks like to be a scholar who is ready for school and bringing
their best self each day. 💗 Thank you for helping your scholar stay organized and keeping up with
everything coming home this week! We hope you have a wonderful Monday! 🌸

events.title: Inside the Spark | One School Newsletter: 🌧️ A Little Rain and A Lot of Gratitude 🍂❤️
events.description:
** Inside the Spark!
The Newsletter of One School of the Arts & Sciences....... "Planted in the house of the Lord, They will flourish in the courts of our God. [Growing in grace] they will still thrive and bear fruit and prosper in old age; They will flourish and be vital and fresh [rich in trust and love and contentment];” Psalms 92:13-14 AMP A Little Rain and A Lot of Gratitude November rain tapped at our classroom windows this week, keeping us inside for much of the day. We missed our time outdoors, but just beyond the glass, the rain was rinsing dust from the leaves and soaking into the soil, giving thirsty roots the water they need for new growth. The rain changed our plans, but it didn’t stop a Thanksgiving tradition. Thanks to our culinary department, our K–2 scholars still got to enjoy their Thanksgiving tasting together. Sometimes a change of plans helps us notice what makes a tradition special in the first place. This November, we’re grateful for the hands that prepared the tasting and for the chance to share it, rain or shine. 🗓️ Notable Dates

7th Grade Spotlight Our seventh grade scholars had an incredible week of hands-on learning and discovery! 🐸🔎 From dissecting frogs in science to cracking codes that brought History lessons to life, our scholars were challenged to think critically, step outside their comfort zones, and embrace new experiences! But the learning went beyond the classroom lessons! Some scholars faced fears, discovered new confidence, and realized they were capable of more than they imagined. 💡 We love seeing our scholars grow in knowledge, courage, and curiosity. Science and history were definitely highlights this week, and it's easy to see why! ✨ The Giving Corner 🛍️ Christmas Shoppe
